English-language admission requirements:
 If the prospective student’s first language is not English, and they have not completed
their undergraduate or a taught masters program through English, then they must have
passed one of the English-language tests at the appropriate level, as described
immediately above, before they can be admitted.
 The examination results must be less than 2 years old.
 Any student who meets the School of Physics requirement but not the UCD
requirement must complete a 5-credit English for Academic Purposes module in the
Applied Languages Center (ALC). This module can be taken as part of the student’s
30-credit taught module requirement. For this course the student must undergo a
placement test to assess their level of English so that they will be placed in a class at the
appropriate level. This module must be successfully completed before the student can
undergo the Stage 1 Transfer Assessment.
 We would encourage all graduate students who do not have English as their first
language to consider taking the ALC English for Academic Purposes module for credit.
 Students should also consider the intensive pre-sessional language courses offered by
the ALC in the weeks before term starts (additional fee implication)
